description: Source code for Git's tree walk functionality, including decoding, initializing, and traversing tree objects, along with managing traverse state and handling symlinks.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Decodes a tree entry from a buffer, validating and extracting mode, path, and object ID.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with object data and optional error reporting.

methods.name: void init_tree_desc(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure, aborting on error.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Attempts to initialize a tree_desc, returning error code and logging error instead of aborting.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_descriptor(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and fills a tree_desc structure.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Updates the current tree_desc with the next entry, decoding it.

methods.name: void update_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates the tree_desc to the next entry, aborting on error.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates the tree_desc to the next entry, returning error code and logging instead of aborting.

methods.name: int tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current entry from the tree_desc, optionally advancing.

methods.name: int tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current entry from the tree_desc, advancing gently on error.

methods.name: void setup_traverse_info(struct traverse_info * info,const char * base)
methods.description: Initializes traverse_info with a base path and registers statistics reporting if enabled.

methods.name: char * make_traverse_path(char * path,size_t pathlen,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Constructs a full path string for traversal purposes.

methods.name: void strbuf_make_traverse_path(struct strbuf * out,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Creates a traverse path and appends it to a strbuf.

methods.name: int traverse_trees(struct index_state * istate,int n,struct tree_desc * t,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Recursively traverses multiple trees based on index state and traversal info, applying a callback at each point.
